# Rotten Tomatoes

> > The world's most trusted recommendation resource for quality entertainment, aggregating movie and TV show reviews with the Tomatometer scoring system.

Rotten Tomatoes is the leading aggregator of film and television criticism, featuring reviews from thousands of Tomatometer-approved critics across traditional publications, digital outlets, podcasts, and independent platforms. The site provides comprehensive critic profiles, movie trailers, and audience ratings to help viewers make informed entertainment choices.

## Key Topics

- Tomatometer
- Tomatometer-approved critics
- Film criticism
- Movie reviews
- TV show reviews
- Critic publications
- Publication profiles
- Tomatometer scoring
- Film critics
- Movie trailers
- Audience ratings
- Entertainment reviews
- Critic approval status
- Review aggregation
